task.title: Resolve materialized recurrence provenance by task identity
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/895 by resolving one exact materialized recurrence occurrence from a caller-owned task identity through strict read-only replay.
acceptance_criteria: Return complete recurrence-occurrence provenance for one exact bound task and None for an unrelated task.
Reject multiple selected bindings as typed ambiguity and fail closed on malformed selected evidence.
Isolate exact lookup from malformed unrelated materialization markers and grant no lifecycle or execution authority.

attempts.diagnostic: Kernel integration tests failed because find_materialized_by_task_id did not exist. Exact absence, ambiguity, selected corruption, and unrelated-marker isolation had no API.
attempts.patch: Added focused integration coverage for the acceptance contract before adding production behavior.

attempts.diagnostic: Added an exact event-log marker query, canonical occurrence-stream parsing, strict selected-state projection, and typed AmbiguousTaskBinding evidence.
attempts.patch: Added an exact event-log marker query, canonical occurrence-stream parsing, strict selected-state projection, and typed AmbiguousTaskBinding evidence.

attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit found no current defect; it documented optional decoded-task defense-in-depth and a future event_type index. Both were kept out of the bounded read-contract slice because exact SQL matching was already authoritative and schema migration/performance work requires separate evidence.
attempts.patch: Shared occurrence-state projection and marker replay paths instead of duplicating persisted/materialized decoding. Reran the complete repository quality gate after the exact implementation state was ready.

outcome.summary: The kernel can resolve exact materialized recurrence provenance from a task identity while rejecting ambiguity and isolating unrelated malformed markers.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0178-recurrence-provenance-by-identity.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 185 records: 185 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: Reverse provenance must replay and validate every selected canonical stream instead of trusting marker payloads as a complete projection.
Exact JSON marker filtering limits corruption scope, while duplicate bindings must remain typed corruption rather than first-row selection.
Optional indexes and redundant assertions should not silently expand a bounded correctness slice into schema migration work.
Read-only provenance lookup grants no recurrence lifecycle, catch-up, dispatch, permission, retry, or execution authority.
